scenarios.prompt:
Compute SaaS unit economics for the monthly board deck:

  new_mrr: 85000, expansion_mrr: 18000, contraction_mrr: 6000, churned_mrr: 12000,
  starting_mrr: 620000, ending_mrr: 705000,
  sales_and_marketing_cost: 340000, gross_margin: 0.78, monthly_churn: 0.019,
  cash_burned: 450000, new_arr_added: 1020000

Report: nrr, grr, saas_quick_ratio, magic_number, burn_multiple.

Formulas:
  NRR = (starting_mrr + expansion - contraction - churned) / starting_mrr
  GRR = (starting_mrr - contraction - churned) / starting_mrr
  SaaS Quick Ratio = (new_mrr + expansion_mrr) / (contraction_mrr + churned_mrr)
  Magic Number = (new_arr_added / sales_and_marketing_cost) — check methodology
  Burn Multiple = cash_burned / new_arr_added
